# Central Ohio Window Guide

> A homeowner resource covering smart home window automation, motorized shades, blinds, shutters, and window treatment costs in Columbus and Central Ohio.

## Guides
- [The Complete Guide to Smart Home Window Automation in Central Ohio](https://centralohiowindowguide.com/smart-home-window-automation-central-ohio/): how motorized shades work, Matter-over-Thread, voice control, power options, retrofitting, and installed costs.
- [How Much Do Motorized and Custom Shades Cost in Central Ohio?](https://centralohiowindowguide.com/motorized-shades-cost-central-ohio/): 2026 installed price ranges for motorized shades, roller and solar shades, cellular shades, blinds, and plantation shutters.
